name: ashoka-pillar-vaishali
coordinate_method: Published point, not GNSS survey. Heading and minor dimensions marked as estimates below.
geometry_notes: The Government of India Ministry of Tourism Bihar perspective plan describes the Kolhua pillar as11m high; this visible overall extent is used. District and state promotional pages instead give18.3m without specifying a datum. The plan documents the excavated site and is prioritized for the visible model. Sandstone shaft, bell capital, abacus and single north-facing seated lion retain photo-based proportions. No claim is made to reproduce a measured architectural survey.
placement_notes: Wikidata coordinate26°0′50.393″N85°6′32.440″E converted to26.01400,85.109011. Lion faces true north (+z), registry heading0. The pillar footing avoids the adjacent brick stupa and tank; neither terrain nor tank is modified.

grounding.datum: Surveyed anchor with rigid component offsets from raw production elevation
grounding.terrain_modification: None. Terrain shape and material remain unchanged. Only authored geometry moves and its buried supports extend to sampled ground.
grounding.components: One connected column and its footing

rights: All mesh geometry and surface tinting originally authored for Low Poly Earth. No third-party mesh, texture, photograph or inscription artwork is incorporated.
